name: plasma-same-session-computer-use
description: Exact KWin window capture and recoverable focus/restoration leases for Plasma Wayland.

interface.shortDescription: Background capture and focus restoration for Plasma.
interface.longDescription: Extends Computer Use on Plasma Wayland with stable KWin window IDs, exact compositor-side window capture, and acknowledged focus/restoration leases. The lease journals desktop and focus state but does not authorize or gate a separate global-input tool.
defaultPrompt: Use my existing Plasma application in the background.
Capture an exact KWin window without changing my desktop.
Operate this Plasma window with a recoverable focus lease.
